title: Purified Water systems by industry | Aquemi
meta: Purified Water by industry: where it goes and who sets the limit, for drug, device, hospital, lab, cosmetics, food and industrial plants. No WFI.
headline: Your product sets the grade
lead: For drug, natural health product, device and cosmetic makers, hospitals, laboratories, food and industrial plants. One modular Purified Water package, configured to the limit your industry sets.
primary_cta_intent: I know my product, not my water spec

blocks.intro: One Purified Water package, configured to each use, across all five. What changes is where the water goes and who writes its limit.

items.d: Granulation fluid, coating suspensions, syrups and drops, cream water phase, final equipment rinse; veterinary lines too.
Final rinse after cleaning, intermediate rinses, diagnostic reagent and ophthalmic solution make-up.
Washer-disinfector final rinse, endoscope reprocessing, analyzer feed, reagent and buffer make-up, lab building loops.
Water phase of creams and lotions, shampoos and gels, over-the-counter sunscreens, household products, filler rinse.
Spirits proofing, beverage and ingredient water, cannabis extracts, electronics rinse, chemical batches, boiler and electrolyser feed.

blocks.intro: Someone writes your water limit: a pharmacopoeia, ANSI/AAMI ST108:2023, ASTM D1193-24 or CLSI GP40, your recipe or your equipment maker. The industry decides which; the water train stays the same.

stages.d: Your city or well water. Its analysis sizes the pretreatment, whatever you make.
A polyvinyl chloride (PVC) train removes chlorine, hardness and particles before reverse osmosis (RO). The same in every industry.
RO, then deionization (DI) or electrodeionization (EDI) where your grade needs it. The outlet is designed to meet your limit-writer’s number.
Fitted where your use needs stored water; configurations confirmed when you enquire.
Changes by industry: how often it is sanitized, and whether an endotoxin limit applies.
Changes by industry: what you sample and the records you file, at the product, rinse, washer, bench or electrolyser.

blocks.base: Monitoring and controls · alarm limits from your limit-writer
blocks.caption: What stays the same: the stages and their materials. What changes: sanitization, monitoring and documents.

items.q: Do you supply Water for Injection (WFI)?
items.a: No. We supply Purified Water (PW) packages, not Water for Injection (WFI), pure steam or stainless steel systems. Where a product needs WFI, PW is the usual feed to the WFI system.

items.q: My industry is not listed. Can you help?
items.a: Yes, if an ambient Purified Water system fits your use. Send your standard, its edition and grade, and where the water is drawn: each tap, machine or line.
